subject_line: Application for MERN Stack Developer — Ayushkumar Burde
body:
MERN Stack Developer with a Computer Science degree applying for the MERN Stack Developer role. I want to build responsive web interfaces using React.js and Node.js for your startup.

I built a client inventory management system using React.js and Node.js, covering the requirement for RESTful APIs. I also developed an AI-powered resume builder using React and FastAPI, which demonstrates asynchronous request handling and scalable code.

I bring hands-on experience with the full product development lifecycle to your team. Let’s discuss how I can contribute.
